title: Wu–Magnant–Nowbandegani–Xia conjecture for multicolor Ramsey numbers of cherries
statement:
Let $k,n_1,\ldots,n_k$ be positive integers, and let $n=\max\{n_1,\ldots,n_k\}$. Here $P_3$ is the path on three vertices, also called a cherry, and $R(n_1P_3,\ldots,n_kP_3)$ denotes the $k$-color Ramsey number for vertex-disjoint unions of the indicated numbers of cherries.

**Wu–Magnant–Nowbandegani–Xia conjecture.**

$$
R(n_1P_3,\ldots,n_kP_3)=2n+\sum_{i=1}^{k}n_i-k+1.
$$

The formula is known to be a general lower bound, arising from the standard construction for multicolor matching Ramsey numbers. The conjecture asserts that this lower bound is always tight; the general multicolor case remains open.
source_name: Yanbo Zhang, Qian Chen and Yaojun Chen, “Ramsey numbers and Gallai–Ramsey numbers of disjoint unions of cherries”, arXiv:2605.02793 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02793

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2026).
